name: my-instrument
notes: Copy this file to instruments/<slug>.json. Drums: type 'drums', fill 'lanes' (lane name -> MIDI note) and 'fallbacks'. Melodic: set range, articulation_mode (none | velocity | keyswitch | keyswitch+velocity), keyswitch notes and/or velocity bands. latching=true means one keyswitch note at each articulation change; false means the keyswitch is held for every note it applies to.
